messages:
Ari: Scheduling coordinated rollout for API, Runtime, Router, Console in the late window (02:30 UTC). Shared-config bump v12 -> v13. Need quick thumbs from console + router before we kick.

deploy-bot: New rollout created by Ari for 2051129999. Targets: api(v1.8.0), runtime(v4.0-q), router(v0.9.3), console(v2.3.1). Rollout strategy: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with health checks between steps. Canary window: 10m. Exclusions: dedicated-eu pool.

Nina: Console is on the v2.3.1 branch in staging. The schema migration is included. I'll run a quick smoke to make sure the admin UI packets are unaffected.

Sam: Router-team: we merged passthrough for X-Client-Retry header earlier today. Prod canary is healthy. We'll add a temporary rule to redirect to runtime-legacy on spike.

Ari: Health gates: 5xx_rate and dropped-conns. Abort conditions: 5xx_rate > 1.5x baseline OR dropped-conns > 0.5% absolute for 4m. Also observe p95 latency; if p95 increases >30% for >5m we hold.

ops-sre: Standby. Adding alert rule late-window-rollout-2051129999. Will bump shard autoscale buffer +20% for 1h. Posting quick rollback steps in thread.

Nina: One note: console telemetry sampling will be 100% for the first 2m of the canary to help debugging. Will revert to normal after 1h.

Ari: Good. Fallback wiring: deploy-bot supports a soft-fallback label. Use runtime=canary with label fallback-group=runtime-legacy. Example command below.

```
# attach fallback group to canary
deploybot set-fallback --thread 2051129999 --group runtime-legacy --metric 5xx_rate --threshold 1.5
```

Sam: Router team will add route with failover. We'll pre-create the runtime-legacy label set so the switch is instantaneous.

ops-sre: Runbook snippet: 1) pause rollout via deploy-bot pause 2051129999 2) execute deploy-bot traffic-shift --from canary --to pinned-prev --sync 3) validate health for 5m 4) page SRE if step 3 fails. I'll link full runbook: repo://ops/runbooks/rollbacks/2051129999.md

Ari: Release note blurb suggestion: "Shared-config v13: router header passthrough enabled; normalized retry header semantics; console sampling increased during rollout for observability." Keep it short for the release digest.

deploy-bot: Canary start 2051130010 1% traffic to canary. Monitoring enabled.

Nina: quick smoke: admin UI looks good on staging, no schema errors.

Sam: seeing stable on router canary, no header drops. preparing fallback route.

ops-sre: Alert hooks all set. baselines captured.

Ari: 2051130065 1% -> 25%. watching 5xx and p95.

Nina: p95 +8%, 5xx stable. No action from console.

Ari: advancing to 75% at 2051130095. If all green after 10m we finish.

deploy-bot: Rollout at 2051130130 1% -> 75%. Health gates passing.

ops-sre: minor uptick in dropped-conns in one shard, we added cushion. No abort.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete 2051130150 100% traffic. No aborts triggered. Release note saved at repo://releases/2051129999/rn.md

Ari: Leaving console sampling flag for 30m as extra telemetry. I'll follow up with dedicated-eu upgrade ticket for runtime image. Great coordination, team.

Sam: filing a short post-deploy checklist item for the router failover test in staging tomorrow.

Nina: I'll push the RN to the releases repo and ping support about the schema change.
